summary: Eni S.p.A., an Italian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting open-market treasury-share purchases on Euronext Milan under the second tranche of the buyback program approved by the Shareholders' Meeting on 6 May 2026, intended as additional shareholder remuneration beyond dividends. From 7 to 11 September 2026 Eni acquired 3,163,576 shares, equal to 0.10% of share capital, at a weighted average of EUR 23.7073 per share for EUR 74,999,937.06 total. Since the program began on 8 May 2026, Eni has bought 69,374,769 shares (2.29%) for EUR 1,564,915,841.22, and holds 156,202,876 treasury shares, 5.16% of capital.
